assets.prompt: A sheet of NINE separate flat hand-drawn travel illustrations arranged in a clean 3-column by 3-row grid on a plain pure white background, WIDE empty white gutters between every illustration and a wide white margin around the grid, each one a single isolated subject with a thick organic silhouette, no ground line and no shadow, all sharing the same gouache paint texture with soft grain, warm muted palette of terracotta, sand beige, dusty teal and cream, clean rounded shapes, minimal cozy storybook style. Row 1: a small flock of white gulls with red beaks wheeling above a willow-fringed lake pavilion; a cluster of tall narrow grey limestone karst pinnacles with a thin path winding between them; three slender white pagodas standing in a row in front of a long snow-capped ridge. Row 2: a white-walled grey-tiled courtyard house with painted eaves and a carved screen wall; a snow-capped mountain ridge with one slim cable-car pylon and a thin cable; three terraced turquoise pools stepping down over low pale weirs with two small pines. Row 3: a cluster of grey-tiled sloping roofs above a small arched stone bridge over a narrow water channel; a square of indigo-blue tie-dyed cloth with white sunburst patterns hanging from a bamboo pole; a harbour skyline at dusk with a large white sail-shell opera house and a wide steel arch bridge. No borders, no text, no watermark

assets.name: yn-journal-sheet
assets.prompt: A sheet of NINE separate vintage 1970s film photographs arranged in a clean 3-column by 3-row grid on a plain pure white background, WIDE empty white gutters between every photo and a wide white margin around the grid, each photo a simple borderless rectangle, all in matching faded warm Kodachrome tones with film grain and slight vignetting. Row 1: a city park lake at dawn with white red-beaked gulls wheeling over a small red lakeside pavilion; a field of tall grey limestone pinnacles rising out of green grass under a high sky; three slender white pagodas mirrored in a still pool with a long snow ridge behind them. Row 2: a wide blue mountain lake with a weathered wooden jetty and one small fishing boat; a whitewashed courtyard farmhouse with painted eaves at the edge of a stubble field; lengths of indigo-dyed cloth hanging to dry on lines in a village yard. Row 3: a wooden boardwalk on a bare snow ridge in thin bright air above a sea of cloud; terraced turquoise pools below a snow mountain, pines at the water's edge; a narrow night lane of grey-tiled roofs with red lanterns strung above a stone water channel. No borders, no text, no watermark

assets.name: yn-splash-sheet
assets.prompt: A product sheet of NINE separate items arranged in a clean 3-column by 3-row grid on a plain pure white background, with WIDE empty white gutters between every item and a wide white margin around the whole grid so each is clearly isolated and never touches another. ALL NINE painted in the identical Supercell Brawl Stars splash art style: hand-painted stylized 2.5D, soft airbrushed volume shading inside bold clean silhouettes, chunky exaggerated proportions, magenta and cyan rim light. Row 1 first: a single hand-painted game title plate of thick painterly capital letters with heavy dark outlines and glossy bevelled faces, spelling exactly two centred lines of the SAME letter height, the first line reading SOUTH OF THE and the second line reading CLOUDS, with a wide empty margin around the plate and nothing else inside or over the letters. Row 1 second: a large floating rock chunk with a chunky twin-peaked snow mountain on top, dark green pines around its base and small floating rock bits below. Row 1 third: a floating grass chunk holding a small round green lake with a chunky red-roofed lakeside pavilion and three tiny white birds above it. Row 2 first: a floating rock chunk crowded with tall narrow grey limestone pinnacles and a thin winding path. Row 2 second: a floating grass chunk with three chunky slender white pagodas in a row and a strip of blue lake water along its front edge. Row 2 third: a floating chunk of grey-tiled sloping roofs with a tiny arched stone bridge and a thin stream running off the edge as a small waterfall. Row 3 first: a floating chunk of blue-white glacier ice with a slim cable-car pylon and one cable, thin mist below. Row 3 second: a floating wetland chunk of green reeds with a small wooden rowing boat and two tiny geese. Row 3 third: a floating chunk with a black-tiled open pavilion beside a still dark pool reflecting a small snow peak. No shadows on the white background, no text or letters anywhere except the two title lines in the first item, no labels
